title: Stash Tool – Cocobolo/Maple/Bubinga
description:
This handy little tool was previously only available when purchasing an ER Dynastash. But now is available and can fit in any dynastash that has the third small whole. And at this stage all dynastahes we currently stock has this hole.
The metal point is made from titanium and the wooden handle is made from a beautiful Bubinga wood. The wooden handle also houses a magnet in the end.
Please note that these tools are not made to exact specifications and slight angle of the metal point and and being out of centre is normal for this tool. This is shown in the pictures provided on this page.
Included
1 x Stash Tool (Please choose wood type)
